title: Integration Plan
description: DESIGN-stage artifact. Output of method-integration-planner. Declares how the new method integrates into the existing codebase relative to conditions. Schema enforces: exactly one condition must be the baseline with module:null; at least one non-baseline treatment condition must be present.

from_matrix_ref.description: Reference to the experiment_matrix this plan integrates

conditions.description: Integration entries for each condition. Exactly one must have module:null (the baseline). At least one must NOT have module:null (a treatment).

module.description: Python module path for this condition's method. null = this is the baseline (no new module needed).

entry_point.description: Script or function entry point for this condition

patch_description.description: What code changes are needed to integrate this condition

shared_infra_notes.description: Notes on shared infrastructure (data loaders, metrics, etc.) that must remain identical across conditions

allOf.description: Exactly one baseline condition (module:null) is required. minContains/maxContains on the same contains schema enforces the exactly-one constraint per JSON Schema draft 2020-12.
At least one treatment condition (module is a non-null string) is required. A plan with only baselines and no treatments is rejected.
